acceptance: The stable package exports a closed v1 domain node-kind vocabulary with required and optional attribute fields and field types per kind, without framework, model-provider, or database coupling.
Deterministic node validation rejects unknown node kinds, unknown attribute fields, missing required fields, and wrong field types, each with a stable error code.

Issue collection is total and deterministic: the same input yields the same ordered issue list across repeated runs, node insertion orders, and JSON object key orders, under a documented phase order and sort key.

The throwing validator and the issue-collecting validator agree exactly on issue code, target, field, and message, and a core v1 structural violation surfaces as exactly one deterministic DOMAIN_CORE_CONTRACT_INVALID issue.
Domain validation does not mutate, reorder, or normalize its input, and well-formed Product Graph v1 canonical revision identity is unchanged by domain validation.

OCR-004 is repaired: cyclic or over-deep canonical JSON input is rejected deterministically with a TypeError and never raises a stack overflow, while canonical revision identity for well-formed documents is unchanged.
Focused domain node tests plus the full repository format, lint, typecheck, and test suites pass on the exact candidate, and Ubuntu and Windows CI both pass.
Diffcipline exact-candidate proof, Alibaba OCR deterministic accounting/rule resolution with semantic review, and Jev typed judgments are recorded before guarded merge.

required: Stable @ineractive/product-graph v1 domain node-kind vocabulary plus a deterministic node validator and focused tests.
Proof that well-formed Product Graph v1 revision identity is unchanged and that malformed canonical JSON is rejected deterministically.
Exact-candidate Diffcipline proof, Alibaba OCR deterministic accounting/rule resolution with semantic review, and Jev typed judgments.
Exact-head Ubuntu and Windows repository CI and post-merge fresh-main qualification.

minimality.rationale: Extend the already-qualified stable package with one bounded data-driven node-vocabulary and validator module plus focused tests instead of adding a package, promoting the prototype lab, or introducing a runtime dependency.

requirements: Domain validation composes on top of validated Product Graph v1 core state and must never weaken or bypass core validation, which keeps a single owner for structural rules.
Deterministic validation must not depend on object iteration accidents, wall-clock time, randomness, network calls, or model inference.
The OCR-004 repair carried from SG-000019 must not change canonical revision identity for well-formed v1 documents.

outcome: A stable, storage-neutral domain layer inside @ineractive/product-graph defines the closed v1 vocabulary of product-domain node kinds with explicit required and optional attribute fields, and a deterministic node validator that reports stable error codes in a documented phase and sort order, without changing Product Graph v1 canonical revision identity for well-formed documents.
rationale: IN-P02-S01-T02 is satisfied by SG-000018 + SG-000019, so the dependency frontier is IN-P02-S02-T01. A first SG-000020 draft covering the whole domain model plus the carried SG-000019 hardening produced a 1057-added-line candidate, which Diffcipline v1.0.0 rejected with FAIL (added lines exceed the repository maximum of 600). The unit is therefore split correctly rather than squeezed: this Grain delivers the node-side domain vocabulary and validators, and the edge, relation, and carried-hardening slices follow as dependent Grains.

risk.recovery: Revert the SG-000020 node-side domain module, the OCR-004 canonical JSON guard, tests, evidence, and current-frontier updates; Product Graph v1 contracts, ADR-0003, and SG-000015 through SG-000019 evidence remain intact and no production state is mutated.

scope_in: Add a domain-semantics module to the stable @ineractive/product-graph package defining the closed v1 domain node-kind vocabulary (persona, role, entity, page, action, workflow, permission, assumption, requirement) with explicit required and optional attribute fields and a field-type vocabulary per kind.

Implement deterministic node validation with stable error codes, a documented phase order, and a total ordering of reported issues, exposed both as an issue-collecting function and as a throwing validator.

Define and test the prerequisite behavior when the Product Graph v1 core structural contract is violated: exactly one deterministic DOMAIN_CORE_CONTRACT_INVALID issue carrying the core message, so structural rules keep a single owner.
Repair the SG-000019 accepted-risk finding OCR-004 by rejecting cyclic or over-deep canonical JSON input deterministically instead of raising a stack overflow.

Add focused deterministic tests covering the node-kind vocabulary, required and optional field rules, unknown kinds and fields, malformed values, deterministic issue ordering, collecting and throwing agreement, mutation-freedom, revision identity, and the repaired canonical JSON guard.
Advance specs/CURRENT.md to record SG-000019 canonical closure, the Diffcipline-bound Grain split recorded as negative evidence, and SG-000020 as the active frontier Grain.
scope_out: No domain edge kinds, endpoint-kind compatibility, or relation-level rules such as duplicate relations, self-references, and authorization conflicts; the edge and relation slice of IN-P02-S02-T01 follows as a dependent Grain.
No data-governance, classification, lifecycle, privacy, locale, or external-effect semantics, no Dataset semantics, and no design-system, skill, exploration-branch, or release reference semantics.
No Change Intent, proposed graph delta, Question Gate, Assumption Ledger UI, graph views, compiler, database, Supabase migration, graph database, or remote side effect.
No new workspace package, no new runtime dependency, and no lockfile change; the domain layer extends the existing stable package.
No change to Product Graph v1 public contract semantics for well-formed documents and no relaxation of existing rejection behavior.
title: IN-P02-S02-T01A Implement domain node kinds and deterministic node validators
